Ticket.title: Ticket
Ticket.description: Institutional lost and found ticket enforcing zero-trust attribute masking.

id.description: Unique ticket ledger reference code (e.g., TK-2026-0812)

public_description.description: Redacted public details visible to all observers

hidden_identifier.description: Cryptographic or private verification ground truth (serial numbers, engravings, hidden markings)

match_confidence.description: Algorithmic match confidence score between 0 and 100 evaluated by institutional matching engine

status.description: Current lifecycle status in the public and institutional custody registry

PublicTicketProjection.title: PublicTicketProjection
PublicTicketProjection.description: Public unauthenticated ledger view of active items with sensitive attributes omitted.

/Tickets/{ticketId}.description: Zero-trust master tickets repository storing complete records, hidden identifiers, and match scores.

/Tickets/{ticketId}/public/ledger.description: Sanitized public ledger sub-resource viewable without authentication.
